display_name: Reconstructed Room Stained-Wood Trim Profile Set

materials.baseboard: dark warm stained wood with restrained red-brown undertone, fine visible grain, satin-matte finish
materials.crown_molding: same stained wood family, subtle value and grain variation, low-gloss finish

prohibited_changes: do not change any RoomDefinition dimensions, wall locations, wall height, opening bounds, trim height, collision, navigation, camera, cutaway, or room object placement
do not invent paneling, ornate carving, rosettes, brackets, wall decorations, or trim details unsupported by the source photograph
do not merge trim geometry into the separate window or door assets
do not substitute a flat color change, roughness-only tweak, or one decorative strip for a coherent architectural profile
do not use a high-contrast orange or glossy varnish that departs from the source wood
required_features: source-matched restrained stained-wood color and believable fine grain
recognizable baseboard and crown molding profiles with meaningful silhouette beyond plain cuboids
simple manufactured steps, eased edges, and clean joins consistent with ordinary residential trim in the source photo
profile scale fits the existing 5-inch baseboard and crown envelopes and remains readable at 64 to 330 inch camera distances
material remains distinct from the deep green painted wall without dominating the photographed room
the ArtBrief validation sample contains two adjacent 24-inch profile runs; its length is not RoomDefinition gameplay data
semantic_type: source-matched stained-wood residential baseboard and crown profiles
visual_target: Improve only the existing stained-wood room trim in the reconstructed room. Match the supplied photograph: ordinary residential baseboard, crown, and window casing in dark warm brown stained wood, with restrained grain and a low-sheen finish. Develop a coherent, modestly profiled baseboard and crown with clear manufactured edges and simple stepped or eased transitions; keep the source's plain domestic character and avoid ornate carving. Existing RoomDefinition trim dimensions, walls, openings, cutaway, furniture, and gameplay remain exact. The profile should read at the normal miniature-room overview without becoming a bright outline or visual focal point.
